journey: Hold the key, speak, release, and the words land in the front app.
check: End to end dictation. No runnable check yet: needs a downloaded speech model. The WER harness covers it once the RSI baseline models are on this Mac.

journey: Push-to-talk and toggle modes each start and stop recording exactly once.
check: One start and one stop per gesture, including modifier keys and X11 autorepeat. No device or model.

journey: Paste is safe: text is kept when paste fails, and secure input blocks keystrokes.
check: Clipboard keeps the full text on a failed paste, and secure input sends no keys. No device or model.

journey: Spoken corrections ("scratch that", "no wait") are removed from the transcript.
check: Removal needs the on-device model. No runnable check yet: the cleanup eval covers it when the model is on this Mac, and the prompt tests alone do not prove the journey.

journey: Custom words and corrections are applied to the transcript.
check: Custom word and correction substitution, including multi-word and ampersand cases. No model.

journey: Cleanup runs only where the user chose, and never moves to a cloud provider they did not pick.
check: Provider selection and fallback rules. No model or device.

journey: Download a model: pinned commit, verified sha256, licence entry, held models refused.
check: Catalog pins, hashes, licence rows, and held model refusal. No device or model.

journey: A model already on disk is reused instead of downloaded again.
check: Pinned commit snapshot lookup and the reuse marker. No model.

journey: History survives an app restart.
check: History is read back after a fresh store. No model.

journey: Changing a shortcut: a failed register restores the old binding.
check: Shortcut swap and restore on failure. No device.

journey: Microphone problems are named, and the device only changes between takes.
check: Permission and missing device errors are classified; mid-take device changes are refused. No model.

journey: Remote control from the command line (--toggle-transcription and friends).
check: No runnable check yet: the single instance path needs a running app. No model.

journey: First run: onboarding, permissions, and the first model download.
check: No runnable check yet: the flow needs a running app and a download. No model.

journey: Portable mode reads its marker file and nothing else enables it.
check: Magic string enables portable mode; wrong or missing file does not. No device or model.
